name: erank + scale/opacity L1
tagline: Compactness L1 always on, plus an effective-rank log-barrier (warmup at 7k steps) to suppress needle-floater Gaussians.

key_hyperparams.name: erank_warmup
key_hyperparams.role: step at which barrier turns on

diff_from_baseline: Combines 3DGS-MCMC scale/opacity L1 with the effective-rank log-barrier of Hyung et al., NeurIPS 2024 (arXiv:2406.11672). Pushes effective rank ≥ 2 (planar Gaussians), suppressing needle-shaped floaters while preserving compactness.

name: No regularization
tagline: Lower bound: only the photometric (0.8 L1 + 0.2 SSIM) loss supervises 3DGS — regularizer returns zero.
diff_from_baseline: Trivial baseline: photometric loss alone, no shape/opacity penalty. Sets the floor any meaningful regularizer must beat.

name: Scale + opacity L1
tagline: gsplat's default L1 penalty on per-Gaussian scale and opacity to encourage compactness and sparsity.
diff_from_baseline: gsplat default regularizer (`opacity_reg`, `scale_reg`, coefficient 0.01 each). Encourages smaller Gaussians (limits floaters) and sparse opacity (prunable background); also matches the 3DGS-MCMC compactness penalty (Kheradmand et al., NeurIPS 2024).
